verdict.rationale: The skills themselves can be held and distributed on your own infrastructure. They are plain filesystem artifacts under an open, cross-platform standard (docs-64, docs-47, docs-67). Marketplaces can be hosted from your own git repos or local paths (docs-36, docs-9), and a hands-on probe installed an official skill with no Anthropic account (probe-rt-1). However, the runtime that executes skills is Claude Code, the Claude API's code execution container or Claude.ai paid plans (docs-10, gh-2), and no self-hostable runtime is documented. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted runtime or execution environment, first-party self-hosting guidance, and use independent of Anthropic-hosted models.
